A '''Thermal mine''' was a type of explosive device, that could be detonated via remotes. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of enforcers working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] used some thermal mines when they attacked some couriers in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
